blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Recent school shootings should not be used for political purposes, House prosecution spokesperson and Lanao del Sur 1st District Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said Monday. Alonto Adiong said this after Vice President Sara Duterte blamed the Marcos administration for the three school shootings that occurred this year, including the most recent one in South Cotabato that killed three students.
